description: Chaos and boundary test tools for verifying timeouts, privilege drops, environment scrubbing, and sandbox limits.
systemExtension: Use 'sleep_hang' to trigger supervisor timeouts, 'probe_sandbox' to verify privilege isolation, and 'check_env' to verify environment scrubbing.

tools.description: Sleep indefinitely or for a long period to test escalating kill timeouts.
tools.name: sleep_hang

tools.description: Inspect sandbox privileges (UID/GID) and test filesystem permission boundaries.
tools.name: probe_sandbox

tools.description: Inspect all environment variables visible to the unprivileged tool process.
tools.name: check_env
